scope: Only original6301 Motion validation, all96pairs/192episodes/3seeds/6clockpools/3deletions/2horizons =20736cached vectors. Reconstruct unchanged observed-guard forecasts without model calls.
decomposition: Use normalized5120-space residual e=prediction-target, unchanged train-only normalization and frozen linear position decoder A,b.
Exact orthogonal split onto column(A): visible=||Proj_A(e)||^2/5120; null=total-visible. Null means invisible only to this fixed position decoder, not semantically irrelevant.

Secondary orthogonal128-basis split: task-sensitive span(Q_B Q_C), B-null span within basis orthogonal to Q_C, outside-B. Report within-fork spreads; large constant target residual cannot change ranking.
Task identity: pred_position-truth=(prediction-target)A + (targetA+b-truth); measure readout-consistency, target decoder residual, cross term.
rankings: All fixed before output inspection. No selecting a method/weight from validation grid. All score choices are future-informed diagnosis only. Preserve ties/flat pools.

bootstrap.unit: 96 matched scene pairs; average pools/siblings/seeds inside pair first
bootstrap.CI: 95percentile descriptive unadjusted, no new pass rule

analysis: Compare all score choices on task-optimal agreement and task regret.
On feature/task pair-order conflicts, measure null-overrides-visible and B-null-overrides-B-sensitive signs.
Compare full original choice vs reconstructed float64 choice to expose precision effects.
Report residual energy fractions and within-fork range of each component; do not infer rank causality from energy dominance alone.
Independent QR/SVD reconstruction of every cached vector component and original scalar replay; independent paired CI and ranking replay.
limitations: Readout-specific subspace is not all task semantics.
Synthetic RGB guard and frozen decoder; no V-JEPA claim or byte-budget parity.
Changing a diagnostic score does not repair the full-feature predictor or alter acceptance.
